propositions: CodeHealthConfig.enabled field has zero read sites in src/rebar; it is never consulted to gate structural metric evaluation
Structural metrics (module_size_distribution, oversized_module_count, complexity_summary, duplication_summary) evaluate regardless of the enabled flag setting

The inert-config detection gate cannot catch this field because .enabled is also read on other configs (ui.enabled, LangfuseConfig), causing it to pass despite never being read on CodeHealthConfig itself
Operator decision recorded: remove CodeHealthConfig.enabled field, its coercion row, and its config-surface entries rather than wiring it to gate metrics
Field removal requires tombstone entries in _deprecations.py for both REBAR_CODE_HEALTH_ENABLED env var and code_health.enabled cfg key to warn-and-exit rather than silently drop still-set inputs
